content.name: Kavya Nair
content.title: TGT Mathematics and Grade 8 Coordinator
content.summary: CTET-qualified mathematics teacher with nine years in CBSE schools, now teaching Classes 6–10 and coordinating Grade 8. Known for activity-based maths, I helped my Class 10 batch reach a 94% first-division rate and lifted the school's average board maths score from 71 to 79.

experience.title: Primary Teacher (PRT)
bullets: Taught Mathematics and EVS to 4 sections of Classes 3–5, about 140 students.
Set up a maths lab corner with manipulatives that the school later extended to all primary classrooms.
Ran remedial sessions twice a week for 20 students below grade level; 16 reached grade level by year end.

experience.title: TGT Mathematics
bullets: Taught Mathematics to Classes 6–10 across 5 sections, including CBSE Class 10 board preparation.
Moved all teaching online during 2020–21, using Google Classroom and GeoGebra for 180 students.
Raised the Class 10 board maths average from 71 to 79 marks over three batches through weekly practice tests and error analysis.
Trained 12 colleagues on competency-based question design aligned with NEP 2020.

experience.title: TGT Mathematics and Grade 8 Coordinator
bullets: Coordinate 7 sections of Grade 8 with 9 subject teachers, owning timetables, assessments and parent-teacher meetings.
Teach Mathematics to Classes 8–10; 94% of my 2025 Class 10 batch scored above 60% in the board exam.
Launched a maths Olympiad club of 45 students; 11 qualified for the second level of a national olympiad in 2025.
Introduced a weekly data review of unit test results that cut the number of students below 40% from 38 to 14.

Teaching and Learning in the Digital Age

achievements.title: Best Teacher Award, 2024
achievements.detail: Awarded by the school management for academic results and the Olympiad club.
